question: 'STEM' is related to 'HGVN' in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way. QUIT' is related to 'JFRG'. To which of the following is 'ACCOUNTABLE' related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic: Opposite letter according to the English alphabetic series is written.

​​So,

'STEM' is related to 'HGVN'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44152e5386b87b2a5c9642096d68013a9e46af5bfcb89014607c092187848e8b.png] 

​And,

'QUIT' is related to 'JFRG'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115ecef97a62349d7d661f0fff5124ddad67367603dc4f18b7a473ec563b9e80.png] 

​Similarly,

'ACCOUNTABLE' is related to

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a76818d4ddf15d78671b273040c33103eed9309f414229b2ce9f33e01a93b448.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
